gen_risks.description: Technical risks related to the development of new IT systems and automation of services
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and capacity-building programs for technical staff, and ensure adequate infrastructure to support the development of new IT systems and automation of services

gen_risks.description: Financial risks related to mismanagement of funds or inadequate financial planning
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a robust financial management system, with regular monitoring and reporting to ensure adequate financial planning and management

gen_risks.description: Schedule risks related to delays in implementation or achieving the desired results
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a detailed project schedule, with regular milestones and progress monitoring to ensure timely implementation

gen_risks.description: Stakeholder risks related to lack of coordination or communication among stakeholders
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a stakeholder engagement plan, with regular communication and coordination among stakeholders to ensure their needs and concerns are addressed

gen_risks.description: Political_regulatory risks related to changes in government policies or regulations
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor regulatory changes and government policies, and engage with relevant stakeholders to ensure the project's compliance and success

gen_risks.description: Environmental risks related to potential environmental impacts during construction
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop an environmental management plan, with measures to mitigate potential environmental impacts during construction

gen_risks.description: Organizational risks related to lack of capacity or resistance to change
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and capacity-building programs for staff, and ensure adequate resources and support to facilitate organizational changes

gen_risks.description: External risks related to the impact of external factors on the project's success
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor external factors, and develop contingency plans to address potential risks and opportunities

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
